# Henotic Diagnostics — Full Reference

> Henotic Diagnostics is a NABL-accredited medical diagnostic and imaging center in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, India. Founded in 2012, it provides advanced diagnostic imaging, pathology, cardiac diagnostics, and genetic testing services. The center operates 24/7 and is equipped with 3.0 Tesla MRI, 128-slice CT, digital PET-CT, 4D ultrasound, and automated pathology systems.

## Service Categories

### Advanced Imaging
MRI Scan (3.0T), CT Scan (128-slice), PET-CT Scan, SPECT Scan, HRCT Chest, MR Angiography, CT Angiography, CT-guided biopsy, whole-body scans

### Ultrasound & Sonography
Abdominal ultrasound, pelvic ultrasound, obstetric sonography (NT scan, anomaly scan, growth scan), musculoskeletal ultrasound, thyroid ultrasound, breast ultrasound

### Cardiac Diagnostics
2D Echocardiography, ECG, TMT (treadmill test), Holter monitoring (24/48/72-hour), stress echo, ambulatory BP monitoring, cardiac risk assessment

### Doppler Studies
Color Doppler, carotid artery Doppler, renal Doppler, obstetric Doppler, arterial/venous Doppler, DVT scan, peripheral vascular assessment

### Pathology & Blood Tests
CBC, lipid profile, thyroid function, diabetes screening (HbA1c), liver function, kidney function, complete metabolic panel, hormone tests, tumor markers, vitamin panels

### Women's Health
Digital mammography, 3D breast tomosynthesis, follicular study, fertility assessment, gynecology ultrasound, HSG test, pelvic scan

### Bone Health
DEXA bone density scan, BMD test, osteoporosis screening

### Liver Diagnostics
FibroScan, liver elastography, fatty liver assessment, cirrhosis screening, hepatic stiffness test

### Genetic Testing
NIPT (Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing), karyotype analysis, carrier screening, DNA test, paternity test, molecular diagnostics, cytogenetics

### Health Checkup Packages
Full body checkup, cardiac health package, diabetes screening package, women's health package, senior citizen package, executive health checkup

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What services does Henotic Diagnostics offer?**
A: Henotic Diagnostics provides a complete range of diagnostic services including blood tests, full-body health checkups, advanced imaging (MRI, CT, PET scan, ultrasound), cardiac diagnostics (2D Echo, ECG), women's health screening (mammography, sonography), and genetic testing.

**Q: Is an MRI scan safe?**
A: Yes, MRI is a non-invasive and radiation-free imaging technique using magnetic fields and radio waves, making it safe for most patients. It does not use ionizing radiation like X-rays or CT scans.

**Q: How long does a CT or MRI scan take?**
A: CT scans typically take 5–10 minutes, while MRI scans may take 20–45 minutes depending on the body part being examined and whether contrast is needed.

**Q: Do I need a doctor's prescription for imaging tests?**
A: Yes, most advanced imaging tests (MRI, CT, PET-CT) require a valid doctor's prescription. Basic tests like blood tests and ECG can often be done without one.

**Q: How are reports delivered?**
A: Reports are available digitally through our online portal and can also be sent via WhatsApp. Physical copies are available at our center. Most reports are ready within 24 hours, with many available same-day.

**Q: What should I bring to my appointment?**
A: Bring your doctor's prescription, previous reports if any, valid photo ID, and any relevant medical history. For specific tests, our team will provide preparation instructions at the time of booking.
